observation.5: {graha} sits in your fifth house — you make things, and you mind more than you admit whether they're seen.
observation.6: {graha} sits in your sixth house — you handle what everyone else lets slide, don't you?
observation.7: {graha} sits in your seventh house — you read the room before you read yourself.
observation.8: {graha} sits in your eighth house — you'd rather know the hard thing than be spared it.
observation.9: {graha} sits in your ninth house — you keep looking for the bigger reason behind it all.
observation.10: {graha} sits in your tenth house — being seen as capable matters to you more than you say.
observation.11: {graha} sits in your eleventh house — you carry your people's hopes alongside your own.
observation.12: {graha} sits in your twelfth house — you need a room nobody can reach you in.
